artworks.label: Cloud sleep mask
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for mochi-sleepover. One adorably plush ivory cloud-shaped sleeping mask with two tiny cocoa embroidered closed eyes, soft strawberry-pink cheeks, lilac satin elastic loops and one small buttery-yellow star charm sewn onto a corner. Fine fuzzy plush fleece, tactile embroidered seams, premium soft kawaii craft photography, lilac/ivory/pink/butter-yellow palette. No face wearing it, no bunny, hot-water bottle, lantern, pillow fort, clock or text. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
